---
title: "Slope"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(terra)

bathy <- rast("gebco_2026_n-44.0_s-75.0_w-95.0_e-25.0.nc")

slope <- terrain(bathy, "slope")

tracks_vect <- vect(tracks_vars_behav)

tracks_vars_behav$slope <- NA_real_

vals <- terra::extract(slope, tracks_vect)
tracks_vars_behav$slope <- vals[, 2]

saveRDS(tracks_vars_behav, "tracks_vars_behav.rds")

```
